upload.intro: Send a file for one cycle year. Nothing is rejected: checks raise flags for review.
upload.drop: Drop a CSV, XLSX, XLS or JSON file here
upload.advisory: Checks run after upload. You get a receipt straight away and can follow the result there.
upload.err.type: Use a CSV, XLSX, XLS or JSON file.
upload.err.size: The file is larger than 10 MB.
receipt.title: Upload receipt
receipt.rejected: This upload could not be read.
receipt.advisory: Flags are for review. They show the rule and the numbers; no record was rejected or changed.
home.title: Institution home
home.noneHint: Upload a student file to see its receipt and flags here.
record.name: Name
record.intro: Current records for your institution. Fields masked by the server are shown as returned.
record.audited: Viewing this record is written to the audit log.
cert.title: Student record for certificate
cert.name: Student name
cert.qrAlt: QR code that opens the public check page for this certificate record
cert.scan: Scan to check this record. The check says whether the printed details match what the hub signed. It is advisory and not an official AICTE confirmation.
verify.genuine.cert.body: This confirms that the details below were signed by the hub for a certificate record, the signature is valid, it has not expired and it has not been revoked. It does not confirm anything beyond these details.
keys.intro: API keys let your systems push student data. Each key is stored hashed, so it can be shown only once.
keys.name: Name
keys.once: Copy it now. It is shown once and cannot be retrieved later.
keys.revokeBody: Systems using it will stop working:
rules.intro: Each rule has numbered versions. A change creates a new version; old versions and the flags raised under them stay as they were.
rules.title: Rule
rules.err.object: Parameters must be a JSON object.
rules.hardStopHint: Hard stop only changes how an upload is displayed. It never refuses data.
rules.noDiff: These two versions are the same.
rules.preview.title: Impact preview, cycle
rules.preview.note: Preview only. Nothing is saved until you save the rule.
rules.revertBody: This copies the old version into a new active version. Nothing is deleted.
review.title: Review queue
review.intro: Flags raised by the checks. Each one names its rule and shows its numbers. Nothing here changes a student record.
flag.noRecords: No records are attached to this flag.
flag.stale: This flag changed since you opened it. It was reloaded; check and try again.
flag.advisory: Advisory only: an action records a decision and tells the institution. It never rejects or changes data.
ev.dups: Rows with this APAAR ID, side by side
inst.flags.title: Flags on your records
inst.flags.intro: Read the notes from AICTE and answer where asked. Replying changes no record; to fix data, correct the record.
inst.flags.asked: AICTE asked you a question. Your reply goes to the region officer.
corr.title: Correct this record
corr.hint: Saving creates a new version. The old version stays in the history. Checks run again on the new version. Leave a field empty to keep it.
corr.name: Name
corr.pendingHint: This record is waiting for an APAAR ID. Adding it re-runs the checks.
withdraw.title: Withdraw this record
withdraw.body: The record stays in the history, marked withdrawn.
notif.title: Notifications
dash.title: Dashboard

chart.capNote: The cap is where the grey bar ends.

reports.empty: This report has no rows for these filters.
reports.notRun: Choose a report and press Run.
reports.scopeNote: You see only your own institution.
windows.title: Submission windows
windows.intro: When each institution type must submit, and the reminder ladder sent around the close.
windows.invalid: Check the dates and give every ladder step a unique name.
clock.title: Demo clock
clock.intro: Moves the platform's notion of now so windows and reminders can be shown without waiting. Demo only.
clock.invalid: Enter a non-zero number of days.
error.action: That did not work. Try again.

purpose.REGULATORY.desc: A regulator or statutory body checks records it is entitled to see.

refusal.VERIFIER_NOT_APPROVED: Your organisation is not approved to verify for this purpose.

refusal.NO_CONSENT: The student has not given consent.

refusal.FIELD_NOT_IN_CONSENT: The consent does not cover every requested field.
refusal.UNKNOWN_STUDENT: No current record exists for this APAAR ID.
val.orgName: Enter the organisation name (at least 2 characters).
val.source: Say where the consent came from.
val.expiryFuture: Choose an expiry date in the future.
val.expiryMax: Consent can run for at most three years.
verify.title: Check a verification
verify.notice: Prototype on synthetic data. Not an official AICTE system. Nothing on this page is a real student record.
verify.unreachable: The check service could not be reached. This says nothing about the record. Try again.
verify.offline.ok: Signature valid (checked offline). Revocation could not be checked without a connection.
verify.offline.expired: Signature valid (checked offline), but this token has expired by this device's clock. Revocation could not be checked without a connection.
verify.offline.noKey: No network and no saved public key, so the signature could not be checked. Open this page once while online to save the key.
verify.offline.format: Signature not valid: the token is malformed.
verify.offline.signature: Signature not valid: the token does not match the key. It may have been altered.
verify.offline.key: Signature not valid: the token was signed by a different key.
verify.limited: Too many checks from this connection. Wait a minute and try again.
verify.genuine.body: This record was issued by the hub, the signature is valid, it has not expired and it has not been revoked.
verify.expired.body: The signature is valid, but this verification is past its expiry date. Its contents are not shown. Ask the holder for a new one.
verify.revoked.body: This verification was withdrawn after it was issued. Its contents are not shown and should not be relied on.
verify.tampered.body: The signature does not check out, or the code is not one this hub issued. Nothing from it is shown. Do not rely on it.
verify.keyUnavailable: The public key could not be loaded.
verify.how1: The code in the address bar is a signed token (a JWT). Copy it.
verify.how2: Open the public key link above and compare its key ID with the one shown here.
verify.how3: Check the token's Ed25519 (EdDSA) signature against that key with any JWT tool. A valid signature proves the contents were not changed. Expiry and revocation can only be checked here.
reg.title: Register as a verifier
reg.intro: Employers, institutions and regulators can ask for a student's details only with that student's consent.
reg.approval: AICTE must approve your registration before you can sign in. Approval is not automatic and may be refused.
reg.purposes: Purposes you want to verify for
reg.done: If this address can be registered, AICTE will review it and you can sign in once it is approved. This message is the same for every address.
reg.error: The registration could not be sent. Try again.
reg.limited: Too many registrations from this connection. Try again later.
vr.title: Verify a student
vr.intro: Ask for fields about one student, for one purpose. You get an answer only where the student has consented and the purpose allows the field.
vr.fieldsHint: Only fields the policy allows for this purpose are listed.
vr.fieldsNone: Choose a purpose to see its fields.
vr.fieldsEmpty: This purpose currently allows no fields.
vr.tokenNote: Shown once. Keep it if you need to show it to someone. It is not stored.
vr.qrAlt: QR code that opens the public check page
vr.revokeBody: Anyone who checks the token afterwards will see Revoked. This cannot be undone.
vr.limited: Too many refused requests. Wait a few minutes and try again.
vr.notApproved: Your organisation is not approved to verify yet, or the approval was withdrawn. Contact AICTE.
vr.mineEmpty: You have not made any requests yet.
vr.mineEmptyHint: Requests you make appear here with their outcome.
consent.title: Student consent
consent.intro: Record a consent a student of your institution has given, and withdraw it if they ask. Verifiers get answers only within a consent.
consent.fieldsHint: The consent covers these fields. A purpose's policy may still allow fewer.
consent.sourceHint: For example: signed paper form, portal tick-box.
consent.lookup: Show consents for an APAAR ID
consent.lookupHint: Enter an APAAR ID to list the consents on record for that student.
consent.empty: No consents on record for this ID.
consent.withdrawBody: Verifiers will get no answers under it from now on. This cannot be undone; record a new consent if the student agrees again.
consent.notYourStudent: This student is not at your institution, or the ID is not known.
consent.invalidRequest: The consent was not accepted. Check the expiry date and the lists.
ver.title: Verification requests
ver.intro: Every request to verify a student, with its outcome. Refusals show the precise reason.
vreg.title: Verifier registrations
vreg.intro: Organisations that asked to verify students. Approving activates their account for the purposes they asked for.
pol.title: Purpose policies
pol.intro: Which fields a verifier may ask for under each purpose. A change creates a new version; earlier versions stay on record.
audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Every write, single-record view, export, verification and refusal. Entries are chained by hash; any edit breaks the chain.
audit.ok: Chain intact: all {n} entries check out.
audit.broken: Chain broken at entry {id}. That entry or one before it was changed.
audit.filterNote: Filters apply to the entries loaded on this page.
audit.tamperTitle: Damage the audit log on purpose?
audit.tamperBody: This edits the first audit row directly, without the hash chain. It damages the demo database on purpose so you can see Verify chain catch it. It cannot be undone; reseed the database to repair it.
audit.tampered: Row {id} was altered. Run Verify chain to see it caught.
audit.truncBody: This removes the newest audit rows from the demo database so you can see a signed checkpoint catch the truncation. It cannot be undone; reseed the database to repair it.
audit.truncated: {n} rows were deleted. Run Verify chain to see it caught.
common.privateNote: Prototype on synthetic data. Not an official AICTE system.
users.intro: Create accounts, change roles, regions and institutions, deactivate accounts and reset passwords. Every change is written to the audit log.
users.staffIntro: Manage the staff accounts of your institution. Deactivating keeps the account and its history.
users.createHint: Leave the password empty to get a temporary one, shown once.
users.name: Full name
users.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Empty means a temporary password is generated.
users.deactivateBody: They can no longer sign in. The account and its history stay, and you can reactivate it later.
users.resetBody: A new temporary password is generated and shown once. The old one stops working.
users.tempOnce: Shown once. Copy it now and pass it on safely.
users.err.name: Enter a name.
users.err.institution: Choose an institution for this role.
users.err.password: Use at least 8 characters, or leave it empty.
landing.title: One verified record per student, checked in the open.
landing.lead: Institutions upload student data. Plain rules check every upload and raise flags that name the rule and show the numbers. People review the flags. Employers and others can then verify a record, only with the student's consent.
landing.step.upload.body: An institution sends a CSV, Excel or JSON file, or uses the API.
landing.step.checks.body: Rules look for missing or malformed IDs, duplicates and intake above the approved limit.
landing.step.review.body: An AICTE officer reads each flag with its reason and numbers, and records a decision.
landing.step.verify.body: With consent, a verifier gets a signed answer. A QR code opens a public page that checks it.
landing.statesLead: Each state has an icon and a word, never colour alone.
landing.state.Clear: No open flags. Nothing needs attention.
landing.state.Alert: Some flags are open and waiting for review or an answer.
landing.state.Excess: Enrolment is above the approved intake plus supernumerary seats, or an intake-cap flag is open.
landing.advisoryBody: The platform flags and routes. It does not reject, correct or penalise anyone. Every flag names its rule and shows its numbers, and every action is written to a tamper-evident audit log.
landing.team: Waymark APAAR Hub, by Team Phoenix Crew (SIH 26263).
verify.indexBody: Every verification comes with a QR code that opens a page like this one. The page checks the signature and shows whether the record is genuine, expired or revoked. If you have only the link or the code, paste it below.
